name: Rwenzori Mountains National Park
description: Rising from western Uganda, this park protects the heart of the Rwenzori range, often called the Mountains of the Moon. Its highest summit, Mount Margherita, reaches 5,109 metres, making it Africa's third tallest peak. Visitors find glaciers, waterfalls and lakes, along with strange alpine plant life such as giant heather, and the habitats of several endangered species.
